item.title: Umahi and those who betray their brothers, by Emmanuel Aziken
item.description: David Umahi, Nigeria’s Minister of Works and former governor of Ebonyi State, has built much of his political argument around infrastructure delivery, loyalty to President Bola Tinubu and his disagreement with Peter Obi’s presidential ambition. Yet, a statement he made during the run-up to the 2023 elections continues to raise questions about consistency, political loyalty and the place of South-East interests in Nigeria’s power equation. In June 2022, following the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential primary, Umahi expressed anger that South-East delegates had failed to rally behind an aspirant from their region. He had polled 38 votes, while Tinubu won the ticket with 1,271 votes.
